stanza: “I started writing about my dad and my brother and the pain… My father could us…
Fall and rot slowly on the ground
It won't be long and he won't be around
I love my father, and he could use some mercy now

labor.line: I get mad love, but I detest the labor
labor.linePrev: It's a chore, a fact of life, a labor of love

stanza: You know, to me they look pretty damn free down there
Not having to press those smooth
Not having to smooth those hands against hot steel
Not having to worry about the in-speed

saber.songTitle: The Island: Come and See; The Landlord’s Daughter; You’ll Not Feel the Drowning
saber.line: Produced my pistol, then my saber
stanza: As I was a-ramble down by the water
I spied in sable the landlord's daughter
Produced my pistol, then my saber
Said "Make no whistle or thou will be murdered!"
